name: koha-plugin-notice-testing
description: Notice editor improvements for Koha 26.05 and 26.11: Template Toolkit field picker, and checks before saving notices

scripts.preversion: sed -i -e "s/^our \$VERSION .*/our \$VERSION         = \"$npm_new_version\";/" Koha/Plugin/Com/ByWaterSolutions/NoticeEditor.pm; perl scripts/stamp-changelog.pl v$npm_new_version; git add -u; rm -f Koha/Plugin/Com/ByWaterSolutions/NoticeEditor.pm-e
scripts.postversion: perl scripts/open-next-changelog.pl v$npm_package_version; git add CHANGELOG.md; git commit -m 'Open next development cycle'

author: Lisette Scheer <lisette@bywatersolutions.com>
